name: procucev-realtime-stt
description: Real-time multilingual (Hindi + English) Speech-to-Text web application with PostgreSQL CRUD dashboard and WebSocket streaming (Gemini Live 3.1 / Self-hosted Whisper / Browser STT).

scripts.db:init: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); require('./src/db/pool').initDb().then(() => { console.log('DB initialized'); process.exit(0); }).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });"
